title: Mexican Lamb Shepherd's Pie
description: A twist on the classic shepherd's pie, this Mexican lamb version combines the flavors of the Southwest with a crispy bake topping.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook lamb mixture over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add onion, cumin, chili powder, and garlic to the skillet and cook until onion is translucent.
Stir in diced tomatoes, black beans, and Mexican blend cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, prepare the bake mix according to package instructions.
Spread the bake mix evenly over the top of the lamb mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the bake mix is golden brown.
Remove from oven and top with sour cream, if using.
